production_findings.issue: BUY emergency-close branch still read settings.emergency_offset while SELL used the external emergency_offset reference.
production_findings.fix: Use external emergency_offset for both directions, shared with the evaluator spread value at B1 62560 / B3 6d650.
production_findings.proof: Four boundary fixtures added. The preserved old test EX5 fails native SDK ordering for bid=-20.5 and ask=-19.5 in both bots; current r7 passes all cases.

production_findings.issue: First implementation of Bot1PrepareEvaluationFields still selected inputs.symbol instead of its external symbol reference.
production_findings.fix: Use the external symbol for both empty-string selection branches. The joined check keeps inputs.symbol=DETACHED while execution.symbol is XAUUSD.

test_adapter_findings: The active-flow adapter originally seeded its fields only at the later active start; seed them at the evaluator start and suppress later reseeding.
The new generic SymbolInfoInteger-by-reference adapter initially swapped the value and success reply; use the established SDK argument order.
Real manager calls require ArrayResize; record actual MQL5 post-state and supply that service state, while running native table algorithms unchanged.
ZeroMemory does not shrink a dynamic member array between test cases. Explicitly resize the fixture array to zero before each new independent input.
Native child-entry counters need hooks at each child address, beyond the parent evaluator instruction range.
Session reporting and table-full messages require three-string and seven-typed-argument Print recorders.
